== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Blood [[madra]] is one of the seven primary [[aspects of madra]], alongside fire, earth, [[wind]], [[water]], force, and life. It is a specialized power that directly influences living bodies and flesh. When used for healing, it can remove damaged tissue and facilitate the regrowth of muscle and bone, though it often requires [[life madra]] to smooth out the results. However, [[blood]] [[madra]] can also be highly destructive; it is capable of tearing apart skin, burning flesh like tinder when combined with fire, and causing intense physical pain by striking the bones. It is particularly effective at attacking biological organisms, though it can be less efficient when used against spirits compared to pure or [[shadow madra]]. This aspect is frequently associated with the [[Bleeding Phoenix]], a [[Dreadgod]] composed of liquid [[blood]] [[madra]] and [[hunger]]. [[The Phoenix]]'s influence can manifest as [[Bloodspawn|bloodspawn]]—red, puppet-like entities that rise from spilled [[blood]] to consume [[madra]]. Blood [[madra]] can also be blended with other [[aspects]], such as [[sword]] or [[hunger]], to create more complex and potent techniques. While it can be used to strengthen muscles in powerful bodies, its presence can also be dangerous, as it may attract unwanted attention or cause internal rebellion if not properly controlled.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Blood [[madra]] is a red-colored energy used by various entities and practitioners. It serves as the primary component of [[Northstrider's Remnant]] and is utilized by the [[Red Faith]]. The [[Blood Shadow]] is also composed of this substance. When [[Yerin]] begins using [[blood]] [[madra]], she finds that her existing techniques will require refining to accommodate its introduction.}}
